svg.title: tRNA decoding: position versus payload
svg.desc: The anticodon five prime GAA three prime pairs with codons UUC or UUU via G wobble at the third codon position. A tRNA anticodon selects the codon but the amino acid physically carried is incorporated. Charging consumes one ATP to AMP and pyrophosphate, followed by pyrophosphate hydrolysis.
svg.text: tRNA: decoding and delivery are different jobs
1 Pair antiparallel; wobble is at one end
Its 5′ G can also pair with U: UUU is the extra codon.
2 A mischarged tRNA delivers the wrong payload
But the tRNA is experimentally loaded with alanine.
If accepted for peptide transfer → alanine is incorporated.
Anticodon selects the position; attached amino acid supplies the residue.
3 One ATP molecule, two bond equivalents
No second ATP is consumed by the transfer step.
Attachment is to the terminal adenosine ribose at the CCA end.
